title: Initial results of the Digital Consciousness Model
abstract: arXiv:2601.17060v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Artificially intelligent systems have become remarkably sophisticated. They hold conversations, write essays, and seem to understand context in ways that surprise even their creators. This raises a crucial question: Are we creating systems that are conscious? The Digital Consciousness Model (DCM) is a first attempt to assess the evidence for consciousness in AI systems in a systematic, probabilistic way. It provides a shared framework for comparing different AIs and biological organisms, and for tracking how the evidence changes over time as AI develops. Instead of adopting a single theory of consciousness, it incorporates a range of leading theories and perspectives - acknowledging that experts disagree fundamentally about what consciousness is and what conditions are necessary for it. This report describes the structure and initial results of the Digital Consciousness Model. Overall, we find that the evidence is against 2024

translated_title: 数字意识模型的初步结果
translated_abstract: 人工智能系统已经变得非常复杂。它们能够进行对话、撰写文章，并且似乎能以连其创造者都感到惊讶的方式理解上下文。这引出了一个关键问题：我们是否正在创造有意识的系统？数字意识模型（DCM）是首次尝试以系统性、概率化的方式评估人工智能系统中意识证据的模型。它提供了一个共享框架，用于比较不同的人工智能与生物有机体，并追踪随着人工智能发展相关证据如何随时间演变。该模型没有采用单一的意识理论，而是纳入了一系列主流的理论与观点——承认专家们对意识究竟是什么以及意识产生的必要条件存在根本性分歧。本报告描述了数字意识模型的结构与初步结果。总体而言，我们发现证据反对2024年……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了数字意识模型（DCM），这是首个以概率化方式综合多种主流意识理论、用于系统性评估AI系统意识证据并支持跨系统、跨时间比较的统一框架，并给出了初步评估结果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Digital Consciousness Model (DCM), the first unified, probabilistic framework that integrates multiple leading theories of consciousness to systematically assess evidence for consciousness in AI systems and enable comparisons across systems and over time.
